definitions.explanation: A port or harbor on the coast used for maritime shipping and trade. Refers specifically to ports facing the sea, as distinct from river ports or lake ports.

examples.japanese: ⟦{横浜|よこはま}→横浜：28138_yokohama⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な{海港|かいこう}⟦{都市|とし}→都市：01477_toshi⟧だ。
examples.english: Yokohama is a famous seaport city.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大型|おおがた}→大型：03016_oogata⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{貨物船|かもつせん}→貨物船：22204_kamotsusen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧{海港|かいこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入港|にゅうこう}→入港：14771_nyuukou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A large cargo ship entered the seaport.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{海港|かいこう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{古|ふる}く→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{国際|こくさい}→国際：01406_kokusai⟧⟦{貿易|ぼうえき}→貿易：01727_boueki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{拠点|きょてん}→拠点：05628_kyoten⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{栄|さか}えて→栄える：13104_sakaeru⟧きた。
examples.english: This seaport has prospered as a hub of international trade since ancient times.

notes:
A compound of {海|かい} (sea) and {港|こう} (port). Refers specifically to ports on the coast, emphasizing their maritime nature.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {海港|かいこう}⟦{都市|とし}→都市：01477_toshi⟧: seaport city
- ⟦{国際|こくさい}→国際：01406_kokusai⟧{海港|かいこう}: international seaport
- {海港|かいこう}⟦{施設|しせつ}→施設：02503_shisetsu⟧: harbor facilities

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{港|みなと}→港：01512_minato⟧: port, harbor — the general everyday word for any port
- ⟦{港湾|こうわん}→港湾：14767_kouwan⟧: harbor, port — a more formal/technical term emphasizing the harbor infrastructure
- ⟦{空港|くうこう}→空港：00648_kuukou⟧: airport — uses the same {港|こう} character but for air travel

USAGE:
In everyday conversation, ⟦{港|みなと}→港：01512_minato⟧ is used much more frequently. {海港|かいこう} appears mainly in written, formal, or technical contexts.
